name: Axe
lead: An axe is a tiered tool that can quickly break wood and plant blocks, and a melee weapon with high attack damage but low attack speed .‌ [ JE only ] It has the special ability to perform crushing blows , which disable the use of a target's shield.
Wooden, golden, stone, copper, iron, and diamond axes are crafted using 2 sticks and 3 identical units of tool material. This recipe can be flipped horizontally.

recipes.ingredients: Any Planks or Gold Ingot or Any stone-tier block or Copper Ingot or Iron Ingot or Diamond + Stick
